mangaian_tangaroa.name: First coconut buds
mangaian_tangaroa.notes: Gill records the first buds of newly planted coconut groves as the offering at Tangaroa’s Mangaian marae.

sources.reference: William Wyatt Gill, Myths and Songs from the South Pacific (1876), pp. 19
